title: Bandar Abbas heat anomaly -> XOP/SPY ratio (5d)
hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Bandar Abbas temp anomaly 20d z-score > 1.5 (heat stress on loading ops) leads XOP-to-SPY ratio by 5 days (+); trade long XOP 5d [weather.bandar_abbas.temp_anomaly -> finance.ratio.xop_spy]
message: Not supported: Bandar Abbas temp anomaly vs XOP/SPY ratio r=-0.005 (n=386), best lag 10d r=-0.085 (wrong sign); z>1 long rule 21 trades, hit 57%, excess +0.7%/trade, OOS 6 trades hit 50% - indistinguishable from noise

trade_idea.entry_rule: weather.bandar_abbas.temp_anomaly rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long ratio:xop_spy next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 10 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Null control: Bandar Abbas temp anomaly 20d z-score > 1.5 leads SPY log returns by 5 days (+); trade long SPY 5d - if this also "works", the XOP/SPY result is market beta not heat stress [weather.bandar_abbas.temp_anomaly -> finance.SPY.log_return] (parent: R2-0012)
